invariants.rule: Communication Source Scope identity is stable and path-independent; moving/renaming the same local store cannot create a second logical source scope.
Automatic processing is ineligible until at least one governed trackable operational entity exists; master/reference/descriptive data alone never satisfies the gate.
Unknown external chronology remains unknown; import/discovery/index/current time cannot substitute for missing message/business time.
A canonical Communication has immutable local identity scoped to one Source Scope; fallback canonicalization is versioned/deterministic and collisions preserve candidates rather than silently merge.
Only matched/protected Communications persist reconstructable content; unmatched inspection is transient.
One canonical Communication may link independently to multiple operational entities; removing/correcting one link never removes or mutates the others.
Communication-derived proposals cannot mutate any owning domain before accepted through that domain's command boundary.
Provider terminal RFC evidence/import acceptance/pending cascade proposal never removes RFC direct Communication links; only confirmed local cascade does.
Orphan grace starts only when the last protected dependency is authoritatively removed; default duration is seven exact elapsed days and any restored dependency cancels pending purge.
Due purge revalidates all protected dependencies transactionally before removing reconstructable content and must preserve only non-reconstructable minimized evidence.
Communication purge never deletes operational entities, append-only audit, external PST/OST source, existing portable exports or protected backups.
Coverage/high-water advances only through durably committed provider position/time; failed/cancelled/restarted jobs preserve the last committed point and expose incomplete coverage.
Targeted backfill is identity/range bounded and never globally rewinds unrelated source coverage; Deep Scan always requires explicit confirmation.
At most one ordinary processing run executes per Source Scope; timer/manual/startup triggers coalesce rather than create unbounded parallel work.
MSG draft generation/export is never proof of sending and never creates canonical sent Communication identity or processing coverage.
Terminal communication summaries contain minimized counts/direction/chronology/coverage only and never retain a hidden body or reconstructable equivalent.

acceptance_hooks: path move preserves Source Scope/message identity
unknown earliest time produces warning rather than fabricated coverage
provider identity and fallback collision reconciliation
one message many independent target links
proposal reject/defer causes no domain mutation
RFC provider terminal evidence does not unlink before cascade
seven-day orphan grace cancellation/restoration and due revalidation
coalesced scheduler and crash/cancel checkpoint recovery
MSG draft vs later sent-message provenance
terminal summary survives content purge without body navigation
